answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation through verified work before it can transact at full limits. A newcomer starts as an umber vertex on the edge of the trust graph: it may take small jobs, but its payments clear slowly and its votes count little. Only after consistent, attested deliveries does it darken into a sable, fully trusted node. An attacker spinning up thousands of clones must therefore fund each stake and grind each reputation separately, turning a cheap flood into a costly, slow crawl.
